about_the_game:
Pack your bags and prepare for the next step on your productivity journey!

Hop aboard a magical train and experience Spirit City like never before! Stay on track while enjoying breathtaking scenic locales. Settle into a customizable cozy train that moves at your speed, uncover charming surprises along the way, and discover all-new Spirits on your adventure.

  • Breathtaking Views
    Watch the world slowly drift by with dynamic, moving backgrounds designed to inspire a sense of wonder. From the cozy calming countryside to the dreamy cloudscapes of the Sky District, this magical train can travel beyond the rails to all corners of Spirit City.

  • Spirits to Discover at Every Destination
    From all-new companions to regional variants of classic Spirits, there is an adorable friend waiting at every leg of your journey. As you venture into scenic locations far beyond your bedroom, these Spirits are eager to meet you!

  • Activities in a Brand New Space
    Whether your preferred travel pastime is journaling from your seat, admiring the train's decor, or getting lost in thought gazing out the window, your favorite productivity tools are now available in an entirely new setting. Reading, studying, gaming, everything feels like a fresh adventure when you’re on the move.

  • Customize Your Journey
    Design the coziest train cabin. Swap out the seating, change windows styles, and even customize the charming open-air observation deck. If you need a change of scenery from your bedroom, you’ll find new, refreshing options as you travel in style, your way.
